headline: JPMorgan Asset Management Plans More Active ETFs in China After Debut Hits Cap
summary: JPMorgan Asset Management plans to launch additional active ETFs in mainland China after its first such fund reached its 2 billion yuan ($300 million) fundraising cap on its first day of sales.
why: Global asset managers expanding into China's onshore fund market tap into domestic retail and institutional wealth pools.

impacts.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
impacts.why: High demand for new onshore investment products expands fee-generating asset management operations.
